description: Insurance Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka - Rules of Regulations of Insurance Industry Act
categorisation: This gazette contains rules and regulations made by the Insurance Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka under the Regulation of Insurance Industry Act, No. 43 of 2000. It specifically amends previous rules regarding insurance brokers' accounting requirements and establishes new regulatory frameworks for quarterly reporting. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters as it involves statutory instruments and compliance requirements for the insurance industry.
